External integrations, cross-feature imports, and new dependencies

riskAssessment.reason: Reporting can accidentally recompute or mutate upstream judgments. This Read Model must preserve supplied card facts and fixed buckets without creating new conclusions.
riskAssessment.reviewNotes: Ranking, Stage assignment, threshold distance, rendering, persistence, and delivery remain outside this WI.

reasons: Reporting Read Model code, tests, and evidence require the standard governed review route.

executionDecision.reason: The explicit user authorization covers execution and Contract recording for all 24 roadmap Work Items.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: ResearchCard retains supplied identity, company, Stage label, headline, evidence summary, counter evidence, missing proof, and next-step facts without recomputation.
Top5 enforces a maximum of five ordered cards and rejects duplicate card identities.
Rising, Watch, and Dropped sections preserve ordered supplied cards and reject duplicate identities within each section.
ResearchPacket groups Top5, Rising, Watch, and Dropped into a read-only output boundary without recalculating membership or Stage.
Reporting Domain source contains only pure Read Model logic and standard-library types with no external-system, rendering, persistence, or other-feature coupling.
Focused unit and integration tests cover card facts, Top5 limit, section order, duplicate rejection, packet grouping, and no-recomputation behavior.
The design spec and execution plan record the Reporting boundary, no-goals, authorization, current-WI issue rule, and verification commands.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Keep Reporting Domain independent of external systems and other feature modules.
Reporting preserves supplied membership and facts; it does not recompute Stage, Ranking, Distance, or evidence conclusions.
Preserve ordered cards and explicit counter/missing proof text.
Do not add dependencies for this Contract.
Resolve issues within the current Work Item when they remain inside its Contract scope; open a successor only for a distinct or materially expanded boundary.
Do not introduce trading, price prediction, or capital-action behavior.

intent.problem: The repository has no typed Reporting Read Model that packages Top5, Rising, Watch, Dropped, and research cards without recomputing upstream judgments.
constraints: Retain supplied card identity, Stage label, evidence, counter evidence, missing proof, and next-step facts as opaque read-model values.
Enforce Top5 capacity and deterministic duplicate rejection while preserving insertion order in every section.
Reporting Domain stays provider-agnostic and does not import another feature module or render/publish output.
intent.rationale: A pure Reporting Read Model gives later Markdown, Telegram, and Weekly Radar WIs a stable read-only contract while keeping Stage, Ranking, and evidence decisions upstream.
